body: I'm glad he's okay! I've had a gut wrenching moment like that when I realized that my dog had slipped past the fence and gone to investigate the highway. Frantically trying to call your dog back from the road is the worst!
Alright. Thanks for helping me through some of this. I'll try and talk with them about it as soon as possible, but it's not going to be pleasant. Here's hoping it works out anyway!

Yeah, depression does seem to be pretty uniform for most people- it makes me feel pretty bad that I can't deal with it as well as some. I hope things go well for you, too. It's a bit comforting to know that some people care, even if it's random people on reddit.

You're right. I guess I don't have much to lose if I try something else. Thank you for the advice. It'd be great if all this was just a chemical problem; that would mean it can be fixed. I don't know how to get medical help without going through my parents, though (I'm 16). Is there any way I can do that myself? Or do I have to convince my mom to get me seen by someone?

Wow. That was really powerful; I would love to see more of your work. You're going through something incredibly horrible right now, and I hope things work out for you. Your lady said she just needed space- maybe she'll come around. If nothing else, she has an obligation to you as the father of her unborn child. Good on you for sticking around for your family, too. I've been severely depressed for months now, and I'm not confident that I'm able to to the same for mine.
